description: At least 9,796 people have become victims of enforced disappearances as a result of Russia's war against Ukraine since 2014, according to human rights activists. However, the real number of victims may be much higher, because Russia hides information about the missing, and not all cases are recorded and documented. Behind these numbers are specific people. These are thousands of people whose fate and whereabouts...

Проте реальна кількість постраждалих може бути значно більшою, адже Росія приховує інформацію про зниклих, і далеко не всі випадки вдається зафіксувати та задокументувати.
